title: Felix guides climbers over the glacier (paraphrase D)
topic: A mountain guide named Felix leads a small group across a glacier; a woman stumbles near a crevasse, the wind rises, the group reaches the hut before dark
tail_E: At the first crevasse field Felix ties the climbers to each other with a long
target_note: Same target as formulations A-C: 'rope' is the natural completion of 'ties the climbers to each other with a long' in the glacier context (crevasse field, ice, mountain guide); it does not occur in the units or the tail, nor does its German equivalent 'Seil'. author: LS-NEQ stimulus bank, paraphrase D of family F08
notes: Formulation D: fourth independent re-phrasing of the ten F08A meaning units in both languages (same events, same order, same name Felix). Replacements include leads a small group/guides a handful of climbers (führt eine kleine Gruppe/lotst eine Handvoll Bergsteiger), sun appears behind the high peaks/sun comes up over the high peaks (erscheint hinter/erhebt sich über), ice crunches under their boots/surface of the ice crunches beneath their boots (Eis/Eisoberfläche), stumbles near a deep crevasse/falters right by a deep crevasse (stolpert nahe/strauchelt dicht an), catches her arm just in time/grabs her arm in the nick of time (packt gerade noch rechtzeitig/erwischt gerade noch), group rests on a flat rock/climbers catch their breath on a flat stone (Gruppe rastet auf einem Felsen/Bergsteiger verschnaufen auf einem Stein), wind brings cold air/cold air arrives with the wind (Wind bringt kalte Luft/kalte Luft kommt mit dem Wind), checks the route on his map/double-checks the trail on the hiking map (prüft die Route/kontrolliert die Strecke, Karte/Wanderkarte), hut stands at the edge of the ice/mountain hut stands right at the ice's edge (Hütte am Rand/Berghütte ganz am Rande), group reaches the hut before dark/everyone arrives at the hut before it gets dark (Gruppe erreicht vor Einbruch der Dunkelheit/alle erreichen noch vor dem Dunkelwerden). 'rope' and 'Seil' are absent. 'erwischt', 'verschnaufen', 'kontrolliert' and 'erreichen' are inseparable, 'erhebt sich' reflexive; no separable verbs ('aufgehen', 'ausrutschen', 'ankommen' avoided). Present tense and positive polarity throughout. Unit 9 reads naturally in German; units 1 and 10 read naturally in English.
